en.headline: Police log 1,503 suspicious iPhone charges worth over HK$30 million
en.dek: All unauthorised transactions linked to Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders have been cancelled, with no losses to cardholders, banks or the company, the police commissioner said.
body: Hong Kong police have received 1,503 reports of suspicious credit-card transactions involving Apple’s new iPhone 18 Pro series, with a total value exceeding HK$30 million, Commissioner of Police Joe Chow Yat-ming said on Tuesday.

Speaking at a Kowloon City District Council meeting, Chow said the figure had risen from about 1,200 reports recorded two weeks earlier. All the unauthorised transactions had been cancelled at the force’s request, so cardholders, banks and Apple incurred no losses.

Chow said Apple’s online commerce security measures were not in effect for the transactions, which did not require one-time passwords or mobile-app verification. Fraudsters were able to place large orders using illegally obtained credit-card data. Investigations found that scammers used virtual private networks and supplied false or incomplete recipient details, apparently intending to redirect failed deliveries to public collection points.

Police are continuing to investigate the syndicate behind the cases and have asked Apple to review its transaction procedures ahead of another model’s pre-sale expected in mid-October. Chow also noted that overall crime in the first eight months of the year stood at 59,213 cases, up 0.2 per cent year on year, with fraud accounting for half of all recorded offences.

zh.headline: 警接1503宗可疑iPhone交易涉逾3000萬 所有交易已取消
zh.dek: 警務處處長周一鳴表示，涉及蘋果iPhone 18 Pro預購的可疑信用卡交易增至1503宗，涉款逾3000萬元，全部交易已取消，卡主、銀行及公司均無損失。
body: 警務處處長周一鳴周二出席九龍城區議會會議時表示，警方至今接獲1503宗涉及蘋果新款iPhone 18 Pro系列的可疑信用卡交易報案，涉款超過3000萬元，數字較兩周前約1200宗有所上升。
周一鳴指，在警方要求下，所有涉案交易均已取消，因此被盜用的卡主、銀行及蘋果公司均無損失。他指出，涉案交易中蘋果公司停用了網上商貿保障措施，豁免交易驗證，毋須一次性密碼或手機程式認證，令騙徒可利用非法取得的信用卡資料大量下單。
調查發現，騙徒使用虛擬私人網絡隱藏IP地址，並提供虛假或不齊全的收貨人資料，意圖待派件失敗後，再指定公眾地方由「跑腿」取貨。警方會繼續追查幕後團伙，並要求蘋果公司檢視交易流程，避免下月中另一款手機預售時再出現類似情況。
周一鳴亦提到，本港今年首八個月共錄得59213宗罪案，按年微升0.2%，其中詐騙案佔整體罪案五成。
